allowed_models.description: Model ids this key may use. Empty means every model the workspace may use.

The most calls this key may have in progress at once on one instance. Above it the
gateway answers `429 rate_limited`.

base_url.description: Where managed mode sends requests, for example `https://api.openai.com/v1`.

proxy_base_url.description: Where proxy mode sends the path after `/proxy/{name}`. Defaults to the origin of `base_url`.

proxy_paths.description: Path prefixes proxy mode relays. Empty uses the family's defaults.

oneOf.description: OpenAI and everything that offers an OpenAI-compatible API.
Google's native Gemini API. Proxy mode only in the first release.
Ollama's native API. Proxy mode only; managed mode uses its OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
`Authorization: Bearer <key>`
`x-api-key: <key>`
`x-goog-api-key: <key>`
No credential, for example a local model server.

stream_usage.description: Streams report usage when asked with `stream_options.include_usage`.

cache_control.description: `cache_control` markers on content blocks are accepted. Otherwise managed mode removes them.

thinking_object.description:
An Anthropic-style top-level `thinking` object is accepted as it is. Otherwise managed
mode maps it to `reasoning` and removes it.

normalise_history.description:
The provider rejects consecutive turns of one role and a leading assistant turn.
Managed mode merges and drops them before forwarding.

reasoning_field.description: The field of a message or stream delta that carries reasoning text.

drop_fields.description: Top-level request fields the provider rejects. Managed mode removes them.

Quirks.description:
How an OpenAI-compatible endpoint departs from the plain behaviour (concept section 8.2).
This is data, so that a new provider needs configuration and no release.

oneOf.description: `reasoning_effort: "low" | "medium" | …`

The endpoint has no such field; reasoning settings are not sent.

Item9.description: An object as the API returns it: the common columns plus the resource's view.

reasoning_efforts.description: The effort levels the model accepts, lowest first. Empty when it takes none.

reasoning_min_budget.description: Budget-style models: the smallest budget the provider accepts.

server_tools.description: Provider-executed tools such as web search.

tool_choice_forced.description: Whether a specific tool, or any tool, can be forced.

assistant_prefill.description: Whether the conversation may end with a partial assistant message to continue.

Capabilities.description:
What a model accepts. This is data, editable through the API, so that a new model's rules
need no gateway release.

oneOf.description: The provider rejects the request when the parameter is present.
Accepted only at the model's default value.

ParamSupport.description: How a model treats a sampling parameter.

oneOf.description: The model does not reason, or it cannot be controlled.
A token budget switches reasoning on.
The model decides how much to reason; an effort level steers it.
As adaptive, and reasoning cannot be switched off.
An effort level only (OpenAI-style reasoning models).

ReasoningStyle.description: How a model's reasoning is controlled.

oneOf.description: `thinking: {type: "disabled"}`.
`thinking: {type: "between_tools"}`: the closest this model gets to off.
It cannot be switched off; the lowest effort is used instead.

ThinkingOff.description: How reasoning is switched off on a model that reasons by default.

oneOf.description: The caller marks cache breakpoints.
The provider caches prefixes on its own.

MaxTokensField.description: Which request field carries the output-token limit.

oneOf.description: Being set up. Not callable.
Still callable; responses carry a deprecation notice; new templates may not use it.
Not callable itself. Requests follow the successor where the grant allows it.
Emergency off switch. Returns to the state it had before.

Param.description:
One parameter of a template.

Left out entirely, the template has no opinion and the caller's value (or the model's
default) applies. With `omit`, the parameter is never sent. With a `value`, that is the
default the caller may override, or with `locked` the value that always applies.

effort.description: The effort level, for example `low`, `high`, or `none` to switch reasoning off.

budget_tokens.description: Budget-style models: the thinking budget in tokens.

summary.description: Return a summary of the reasoning.

locked.description: The caller cannot override the value.

omit.description: Never send this parameter, even when the caller does.

omit.description: Never send this parameter, even when the caller does.
